note.value:
Wizards: High Elfs may purchase either a normal color Wizard or a Mage.
Spell Deck: Mages may draw from either the High Magic or Color spell decks.
Power Points: A Mage generates Power Points at the start of the Magic phase. If a Mage goes over their max power value, then decrease to their max and then roll on the Feedback table. A Mage may skip generating Power Points, but then may not exchange or discard spells in the End Phase.
Casting: Power Points can be spent for +1's to the casting attempt (even for Color Spells). If you fail to cast a spell (1's always fail), roll on the Feedback table.
Dispelling Mage Spells: Attempts to dispel a Mage's spell incur a -1 per pip over the casting value of the caster's roll.
Dispelling: Expend the Power Points indicated on the Mage's level then roll the casting value of the spell being dispelled. Before rolling, may expend additional Power Points for +1's to dispell.
Feedback: Roll d6 + Mage level - Power Points used/over; 0 or less Mage explodes, does a random Low hit; 1-2 Mage loses all saved Power Points; 3-4 Mage loses d6 Power Points; 5+: Mage loses d3 Power Points.
